737:t_009:35.en:
$$甲児$$
「Here I come, $$御使い$$! We end the history of cosmic warfare right here!」

737:t_009:36.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Hahaha, come on! I'll play with you for a bit!」

737:t_009:37.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「This $$プロディキウム$$ was meant to be the vessel for the rebirth of the Supreme God! It is the crystallization of our wisdom!」

737:t_009:38.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So this is the seat of a god...! How convenient for us!」

737:t_009:40.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「And then we end it...! Your plan!」

737:t_009:41.en:
$n
「I won't hand them over to you! Our lives, the $$スフィア$$s... our future!」

737:t_009:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ドクトリン$$, $$テンプティ$$! You are the source of the universe's distortion, and we will surpass you right here!」

737:t_009:43.en:
$n
「I'll show you! This is the $$シンカ$$ of humanity that you feared!!」

737:t_010:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Impossible! What is the meaning of this!?」

737:t_010:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「This isn't right, $$ドクトリン$$! How can this $$プロディキウム$$ lose!」

737:t_010:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「If we are defeated here, there will be no way left to stop the universe's great collapse...!」

737:t_010:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You needn't worry about that!」

737:t_010:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「You needn't worry about that!」

737:t_010:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Are you saying you don't care if the universe is destroyed!?」

737:t_010:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Then you're the ones who should disappear!」

737:t_010:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「Do you still not understand!? The ones who lead the universe to its great collapse... In other words, the true $$バアル$$...!」

737:t_010:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「And here I was wondering what you'd say...!」

737:t_010:12.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Of all the things to say, you call US $$バアル$$! Have you no shame, you fools!」

737:t_010:13.en:
$$レド$$
「You seem to understand nothing about yourselves!」

737:t_010:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$バアル$$... In other words, the apostles of the force that seeks to vanish are the ones who try to erase the force that seeks to exist.」

737:t_010:15.en:
$$タケル$$
「That is none other than you, who take lives on your own selfish logic!」

737:t_010:17.en:
$$葵$$
「Because you keep taking lives, the force that seeks to vanish keeps growing stronger!」

737:t_010:18.en:
$$万丈$$
「Now that the $$宇宙怪獣$$ are down, the universe's great collapse will stop once you're gone too!」

737:t_010:19.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I-it's a lie, right...? That $$テンプティ$$ and the others... could be the power that causes the universe's great collapse...」

737:t_010:20.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「I refuse to accept it! I refuse to accept the ravings of mere humanity!」

737:t_010:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's because you look down on us like that that you can take lives so easily and destroy galaxies!」

737:t_010:22.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's enough! You guys are the worst things in this whole universe!」

737:t_010:23.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「W-what do we do, $$ドクトリン$$!?」

737:t_010:24.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are the $$御使い$$! We alone are the one absolute being who will save the universe!」

737:t_010:25.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We will not let you $$バアル$$ violate our existence! We withdraw here, along with the $$黒い太陽#sol$$!」

737:t_010:28.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah, I know! That must be the $$超特異点$$!」

737:t_010:29.en:
$n
「That's the key to repairing all the spacetime thrown into chaos by the $$大時空震動$$...!?」

737:t_010:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$時空震動弾$$ that $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$ of a certain world built...」

737:t_010:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whether by chance or by design, I cannot say, but at the moment of its activation, it briefly made contact with this $$エス・テラン$$.」

737:t_010:32.en:
$$トライア$$
「The reason every parallel world was drawn in is that this universe, which is in contact with all of them, wavered for an instant...」

737:t_010:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That was the power of the thing at the very core of $$エス・テラン$$, the root of this world...」

737:t_010:35.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$ヴィルダーク$$ knew about it...! So that's why he wanted the power of the $$特異点$$, to investigate $$エス・テラン$$!」

737:t_011:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The $$黒い太陽#sol$$ is the source of our power! We cannot hand it over!」

737:t_020:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「What are you going to do, $$ゼロ$$!」

737:t_020:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'm going to stop the $$御使い$$!」

737:t_020:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You think mere humans have a way to defeat us!?」

737:t_020:4.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ told me! Your weakness!」

737:t_020:6.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「$$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$ commands you! $$怒りのドクトリン$$, $$楽しみのテンプティ$$! Obey my command!」

737:t_021:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Has he... been living for this moment...」

737:t_021:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
(He defies a god at the risk of his life...)

737:t_022:0.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Damn...! And I was one step away!」

737:t_022:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But I can't let them be struck down.」

737:t_022:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No way! He shouldn't be able to come back...!」

737:t_022:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now, $$ドクトリン$$, $$テンプティ$$... To the $$黒い太陽#sol$$.」

737:t_012:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Well done on your revival, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Now... let us annihilate them and stop the universe's great collapse!」

737:t_012:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's not it, $$ドクトリン$$.」

737:t_013:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「That bastard! He swallowed $$ドクトリン$$ and $$テンプティ$$ whole!」

737:t_013:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Now the four $$御使い$$s have become one...!」

737:t_013:4.en:
???
「Yes... There are no longer any $$御使い$$s in this world.」

737:t_013:5.en:
???
「No... Humanity, the $$バアル$$, everything will return to nothing once, and I alone will exist in this world.」

737:t_013:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Now, come! $$ヘリオース$$, $$プロディキウム$$!」
